verdict.rationale: MoonPay's documented product is a consumer-facing fiat-to-crypto on-ramp/off-ramp (buy/sell widgets, quotes, session tokens, SDK) for individuals purchasing or cashing out crypto — not a merchant-facing checkout/payment API for accepting stablecoin payments from customers with programmatic settlement confirmation. No evidence pack item describes creating a merchant payment request, presenting a payment address for goods/services, or confirming stablecoin settlement as a checkout/payment acceptance flow.
